title: Singular complexes satisfy excision for a binary open cover
statement:
Use singular simplicial sets, geometric realization and weak homotopy equivalences as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. For a topological space $Y$ and a subset $W\subseteq Y$, let $S_Y(W)$ be the simplicial subset of $\operatorname{Sing}(Y)$ whose $n$-simplices are the continuous maps $|\Delta^n|\to Y$ with image contained in $W$, with the induced face and degeneracy maps. Let $U,V\subseteq Y$ be open subsets with $Y=U\cup V$, and give $U$, $V$ and $U\cap V$ their subspace topologies. The inclusions induce a canonical map of simplicial sets
$$S_Y(U)\amalg_{S_Y(U\cap V)}S_Y(V)\longrightarrow \operatorname{Sing}(Y).$$
This map is a weak homotopy equivalence: its geometric realization induces a bijection on path components and an isomorphism on every cubical homotopy group at every basepoint. The assertion includes empty opens and empty intersections and imposes no separation, compact-generation or connectedness hypothesis on $Y$.

source.place: Chapter 10, §7, final theorem on maps of excisive triads (printed pp. 80–82) supplies the underlying arbitrary-space open-cover weak-equivalence gluing result. The singular-complex pushout formulation is agent-formulated from that theorem together with the realization–singular counit; an archival source for this precise formulation is WANTED.

mathlib_searches.query: Singular complex open cover excision theorem
mathlib_searches.results: Hits concern scheme open-cover equalities and singular homology; no weak-homotopy excision theorem for singular simplicial subsets.

mathlib_searches.query: A simplicial singular subcomplex cover by open subsets has homotopy pushout
mathlib_searches.results: Hits include SSet.Subcomplex.BicartSq.isPushout and MulticoequalizerDiagram, which give formal subcomplex colimits but no open-cover singular excision or weak-equivalence conclusion.
TopCat.toSSet and sSetTopAdj in Mathlib/AlgebraicTopology/SingularSet; these define the singular functor and adjunction but do not state open-cover excision.
Mathlib/AlgebraicTopology/SingularSet.lean:15,17,47 and related singular-homology files; no open-cover weak-homotopy excision theorem.
